purpose: Canonical evidence shard for LORE Crypto History. Card scoring deferred until research and deduplication are complete.

events.title: Hamster Kombat becomes a viral Telegram crypto game
events.summary: Hamster Kombat became a viral Telegram mini-app game; official channel posts documented tens of millions of players and later a large token airdrop.
events.significance: The game became the clearest symbol of the 2024 Telegram tap-to-earn boom and the scale at which mini-apps could funnel users toward TON-based crypto.

sources.title: Hamster Kombat official Telegram announcements

events.title: Pump.fun launches and industrializes Solana meme-token creation
events.summary: Pump.fun states that the platform launched in January 2024. Its bonding-curve model made creating and trading new meme tokens dramatically easier.
events.significance: Pump.fun turned meme-token issuance into a consumer-facing launch flow and became a defining mechanism of Solana's 2024 speculative boom.

sources.title: Pump.fun — company/token history

events.notes: Needs primary platform launch/volume evidence before scoring.

events.title: SEC approves the listing and trading of US spot Bitcoin ETPs
events.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved exchange rule changes allowing multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products to list and trade.
events.significance: The decision ended a decade-long US spot Bitcoin ETP approval battle and opened a mainstream brokerage route to spot Bitcoin exposure.

sources.title: SEC — Statement on the Approval of Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Products

events.title: US spot Bitcoin ETPs begin trading
events.summary: The newly approved US spot Bitcoin ETPs began public trading on 11 January 2024; later SEC filings describe roughly $4.6 billion of first-day trading volume across the products.
events.significance: This converted regulatory approval into a live institutional market and created a major new source of Bitcoin demand and price discovery.

sources.title: SEC filing — spot Bitcoin ETPs commenced trading Jan. 11, 2024

events.title: GBTC converts into a spot Bitcoin ETP
events.summary: Grayscale Bitcoin Trust uplisted to NYSE Arca as a spot Bitcoin ETP following SEC approval.
events.significance: GBTC's conversion completed the legal and market saga that had produced Grayscale's 2023 court victory over the SEC.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC filing — GBTC uplisting approval

events.title: Farcaster launches interactive Frames
events.summary: Farcaster launched Frames, turning social-feed posts into interactive mini-app surfaces that could identify users and trigger on-chain or web actions.
events.significance: Frames created one of the clearest attempts to merge social feeds with lightweight crypto-native application experiences.

sources.title: Farcaster protocol — Frames v2 FIP (notes original Frames launched Jan 2024)

events.title: Jupiter launches JUP through Jupuary
events.summary: Solana aggregator Jupiter launched JUP on 31 January 2024 after preparing a large community allocation and launch pool.
events.significance: JUP's launch became a major Solana community event and helped establish airdrops and DAO participation as central to the network's 2024 resurgence.

sources.title: Jupiter Research — State of Jupiter: Jupuary 2024
Jupiter Research — JUP Minting and Accountability

events.title: Ethena launches USDe
events.summary: Ethena launched USDe in February 2024, using crypto collateral and derivatives hedging to create a synthetic dollar with protocol-generated yield mechanics.
events.significance: USDe rapidly became a major new dollar-denominated crypto asset and revived debate around synthetic, yield-bearing stablecoin designs after Terra.

sources.title: Ethena — first-party history of USDe launch

events.notes: First-party source confirms February 2024; add exact initial production date if a contemporaneous archive is recovered.

events.title: Nigeria intensifies legal pressure on Binance executives
events.summary: Nigerian authorities detained Binance executives and brought tax and money-laundering proceedings amid a broader dispute over Binance's operations and the naira market.
events.significance: The episode became one of the most severe jurisdictional confrontations between a national government and a major global crypto exchange.

sources.title: Reuters — Binance executive court appearance in Nigeria
Reuters — Binance working with Nigeria over executive detention

events.notes: Keep charges and government allegations attributed; do not state guilt unless adjudicated.

events.title: Starknet opens its first STRK community distribution
events.summary: Starknet's first Provisions round opened STRK claiming on 20 February 2024, with more than 700 million STRK allocated across nearly 1.3 million eligible addresses.
events.significance: The distribution was one of 2024's largest Layer-2 token launches and became a major case study in airdrop eligibility and community allocation.

sources.title: Starknet Foundation — Starknet Provisions Program

events.title: Blast L2 launches with native-yield marketing
events.summary: Blast opened its Ethereum Layer-2 mainnet after a pre-mainnet campaign that had attracted more than $2 billion in deposited assets and marketed native yield on ETH and stablecoins.
events.significance: Blast became one of the most visible examples of the 2024 points-and-predeposit model for bootstrapping a new L2 before public mainnet access.

sources.title: Pyth Network — Blast mainnet launch
The Block — Blast mainnet release

events.title: Dogwifhat becomes a defining Solana meme coin
events.summary: Dogwifhat surged into the top tier of Solana meme coins during March 2024, reaching record prices and becoming a prominent symbol of the network's meme-token cycle.
events.significance: Its dog-in-a-hat image became one of the defining visuals of Solana's 2024 meme culture.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Dogwifhat surges to record

events.title: Ethereum activates Dencun and EIP-4844 blobs
events.summary: Ethereum's Dencun upgrade activated at epoch 269,568, introducing EIP-4844 blob transactions for cheaper temporary rollup data storage.
events.significance: Dencun sharply reduced data costs for many Ethereum layer-2 rollups and was a major milestone in the rollup-centric scaling roadmap.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation — Dencun Mainnet Announcement
Ethereum.org — Dencun

events.title: BOOK OF MEME launch fuels Solana meme mania
events.summary: Binance listed BOOK OF MEME (BOME), a newly launched Solana meme coin, within days of its appearance and flagged it as a high-risk 'Seed Tag' asset.
events.significance: BOME's extraordinarily fast path from launch to top-tier exchange listing became a defining symbol of the March 2024 Solana meme-coin frenzy.

sources.title: Binance — BOOK OF MEME listing

events.title: BlackRock launches BUIDL on Ethereum
events.summary: BlackRock launched the BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL), its first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain, using Ethereum and Securitize infrastructure.
events.significance: BUIDL became a major bridge between traditional asset management, tokenized US-dollar yield and public blockchain settlement.

sources.title: Securitize — BlackRock Launches Its First Tokenized Fund, BUIDL

events.title: Singapore expands stablecoin and digital-payment token regulation
events.summary: Singapore brought the Payment Services (Amendment) Act into force from 4 April 2024, expanding regulated digital-payment-token activities; related regulations took effect in stages in April and October.
events.significance: The changes broadened MAS oversight of crypto service providers and added user-protection and financial-stability obligations.

sources.title: Singapore Statutes — Payment Services Amendment Act commencement
Singapore Statutes — Payment Services Amendment Regulations 2024

events.title: Bitcoin completes its fourth halving
events.summary: At block 840,000, Bitcoin's programmed block subsidy fell from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
events.significance: The fourth halving continued Bitcoin's fixed monetary schedule while miners increasingly relied on transaction fees and more efficient hardware.

sources.title: Bitcoin.org — Halving history

events.title: Runes launches at the Bitcoin halving
events.summary: Casey Rodarmor's Runes protocol went live at Bitcoin's fourth-halving block 840,000 on 20 April 2024, providing a UTXO-native convention for fungible tokens.
events.significance: Runes created a new Bitcoin token-issuance wave immediately after Ordinals and BRC-20.

sources.title: Ordinals Handbook — Runes
Casey Rodarmor — Runes

events.title: US prosecutors charge Samourai Wallet founders
events.summary: US prosecutors charged Samourai Wallet co-founders Keonne Rodriguez and William Lonergan Hill with conspiracy offenses involving money laundering and operation of an unlicensed money-transmitting business.
events.significance: The case renewed a major crypto debate over privacy software, non-custodial tools and the legal responsibilities of software operators.

sources.title: US DOJ — Samourai Wallet founders charged

events.title: EigenLayer announces EIGEN and opens its first stakedrop
events.summary: The Eigen Foundation announced EIGEN and its Season 1 stakedrop on 29 April; claims opened on 10 May with more than 100 million EIGEN allocated across the first season.
events.significance: The token distribution crystallized the restaking narrative and made EigenLayer one of Ethereum's defining 2024 infrastructure experiments.

sources.title: Eigen Foundation — EIGEN and Season 1 stakedrop
Eigen Foundation — Season 1 claims open

events.title: Hong Kong lists Asia's first spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
events.summary: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing welcomed the listing of Asia's first spot virtual-asset ETFs on 30 April 2024, including spot Bitcoin and Ether products.
events.significance: Hong Kong became an early Asian regulated market for spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds.

sources.title: HKEX — Asia's First Spot Virtual Asset ETFs

events.title: Changpeng Zhao is sentenced to four months in prison
events.summary: Former Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao was sentenced to four months in prison after pleading guilty to violating US anti-money-laundering law.
events.significance: The sentence marked the personal legal consequence of Binance's landmark US settlement and the fall of one of crypto's most powerful exchange founders.

sources.title: Reuters — Binance founder Zhao sentenced to four months
US DOJ filing discussing Zhao sentence

events.title: friend.tech activity collapses after early social-finance boom
events.summary: friend.tech released its v2 and FRIEND token in May 2024, but the token price fell more than 90% from an initial spike on launch day and activity failed to regain its 2023 peak.
events.significance: The episode became a sharp illustration of how quickly a social-finance phenomenon built on speculative access keys could lose momentum.

sources.title: The Block — friend.tech token price plunges after launch

events.title: Notcoin turns a viral Telegram clicker game into a TON token
events.summary: Notcoin launched NOT on TON on 16 May 2024 after growing its Telegram Mini App to tens of millions of players, distributing more than 80 billion tokens to participants.
events.significance: Notcoin demonstrated a consumer-crypto funnel where millions of Telegram users could enter a token economy through a simple mini-game.

sources.title: The Block — Notcoin goes live on TON
Notcoin Community — May 16 launch posts

events.title: James Howells takes lost-Bitcoin landfill claim to the High Court
events.summary: James Howells filed a High Court claim against Newport City Council on 17 May 2024 seeking access to or compensation for the hard drive he says contains his lost Bitcoin private key; the council's strike-out/summary-judgment application was heard on 3 December.
events.significance: The litigation transformed crypto's most famous lost-hard-drive story into a formal property and waste-law test, with judgment ultimately delivered in January 2025.

sources.title: Howells v Newport City Council [2025] EWHC 22 (Ch)

events.title: UK High Court rules Craig Wright is not Satoshi Nakamoto
events.summary: In COPA v Wright, the High Court's written judgment found that Craig Wright was not the author of the Bitcoin white paper, did not operate under the Satoshi Nakamoto pseudonym and was not Bitcoin's creator.
events.significance: The judgment was the strongest judicial rejection of the most prominent long-running public claim to be Satoshi Nakamoto.

sources.title: Courts and Tribunals Judiciary — COPA v Wright

events.title: SEC approves rule changes for US spot Ether ETPs
events.summary: The SEC approved exchange rule changes to list and trade shares of Ether-based exchange-traded products on NYSE Arca, Nasdaq and Cboe BZX.
events.significance: The order cleared the central exchange-rule barrier for US spot Ether products and extended regulated spot-crypto ETP access beyond Bitcoin.

sources.title: SEC — Ether-Based Exchange-Traded Products Approval Order

events.title: BlackRock IBIT becomes a major Bitcoin investment vehicle
events.summary: By late May, BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) had grown to nearly $20 billion in assets and overtaken Grayscale's GBTC as the largest Bitcoin fund by assets.
events.significance: IBIT's rapid rise demonstrated how quickly traditional asset-management distribution could reshape the Bitcoin investment-product market.

sources.title: Reuters — BlackRock fund becomes largest Bitcoin fund

events.title: DMM Bitcoin reports a major Bitcoin theft
events.summary: Japan's Financial Services Agency said DMM Bitcoin found an unauthorized leakage of customer Bitcoin on 31 May 2024 worth about ¥48.2 billion; later regulatory material identified 4,502.9 BTC as the outflow.
events.significance: The incident was one of 2024's largest centralized-exchange crypto thefts and led to Japanese supervisory action.

sources.title: Japan FSA — Minister press conference on DMM Bitcoin
Japan FSA Weekly Review — DMM Bitcoin action

events.notes: Add DMM Bitcoin/Japanese regulatory primary notice and exact amount before VERIFIED.

events.title: Brett becomes a prominent Base meme coin
events.summary: By June 2024, BRETT described itself as Base's leading meme coin and was being integrated into Base-native DeFi venues such as Seamless.
events.significance: BRETT became one of the clearest symbols of Base's 2024 meme-token culture, though the project's own promotional market-ranking claims should be attributed rather than presented as independent fact.

sources.title: Based Brett press release — BRETT on Seamless

events.notes: Project press release; attribute claims about rank/market status.

events.title: ZKsync launches ZK community airdrop
events.summary: ZKsync's ZK token distribution went live on 17 June 2024, with 17.5% of total token supply allocated as a fully liquid community airdrop.
events.significance: The drop was one of the largest Layer-2 community allocations and became a reference point in debates over airdrop design and user eligibility.

sources.title: ZKsync — ZK token distribution
ZKsync — incident report referencing June 17 2024 airdrop

events.title: Saxony sells almost 50,000 seized Bitcoin
events.summary: Saxon authorities sold approximately 49,858 BTC seized in the Movie2k case between 19 June and 12 July 2024, generating about €2.64 billion in proceeds held provisionally for the criminal proceeding.
events.significance: The sale became one of the largest government-linked Bitcoin liquidations and a major real-time market narrative.

sources.title: Saxony — Emergency sale of almost 50,000 Bitcoins completed

events.title: LayerZero token launch follows prolonged airdrop speculation
events.summary: LayerZero launched the ZRO token claim using a 'Proof-of-Donation' mechanism that asked claimants to donate a small amount per token to Protocol Guild.
events.significance: The unusual claim design turned one of the cycle's most anticipated airdrops into a debate about entitlement, protocol funding and airdrop culture.

sources.title: The Block — LayerZero ZRO launch / Proof-of-Donation

events.title: MiCA stablecoin rules begin applying in the EU
events.summary: Titles III and IV of the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, covering asset-referenced and e-money tokens, began applying on 30 June 2024.
events.significance: This brought major stablecoin issuance and authorization requirements into force across the European Union.

sources.title: EUR-Lex — Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, Article 149

events.title: Turkey tightens crypto-asset service-provider rules
events.summary: Turkey's Law No. 7518 entered into force, bringing crypto-asset service providers under the Capital Markets Board's authorization and supervision and establishing licensing, custody and operating requirements.
events.significance: The law moved one of the world's largest retail crypto markets from partial rules toward a formal service-provider regulatory regime.

sources.title: Turkey Official Gazette — Law No. 7518
Turkey Capital Markets Board — Crypto Asset Service Providers Notice

events.title: Mt. Gox begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash repayments
events.summary: The Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee announced that repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash had been made to some rehabilitation creditors through designated exchanges.
events.significance: The first crypto repayments arrived more than a decade after Mt. Gox collapsed, closing part of one of crypto's longest-running creditor sagas.

sources.title: MtGox — Notice Regarding Repayment in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash

events.title: WazirX loses more than $230 million in a multisig-wallet attack
events.summary: WazirX reported a cyber attack on a multisig wallet involving losses exceeding $230 million.
events.significance: The incident became one of 2024's largest exchange/custody thefts and a major test of multisig operational security.

sources.title: WazirX — Preliminary Report: Cyber Attack on WazirX Multisig Wallet

events.title: US spot Ether ETPs begin trading
events.summary: Spot Ether exchange-traded products began trading on US exchanges on 23 July 2024 following SEC rule approval and effectiveness of registration statements.
events.significance: Ether joined Bitcoin as a crypto asset available through regulated US spot exchange-traded products.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC filing — ETHE/ETH begin trading

events.title: Babylon expands Bitcoin staking concepts
events.summary: Babylon opened Phase 1 of its Bitcoin staking mainnet, allowing BTC holders to lock coins in self-custodial Bitcoin scripts as the supply side of a future shared-security marketplace.
events.significance: By the end of 2024, Babylon reported more than 57,000 BTC had been staked across three caps, making native Bitcoin staking one of the year's largest new BitcoinFi experiments.

sources.title: Babylon Labs — Bitcoin Staking Mainnet Phase 1
Babylon Labs — 2024 in Review

events.title: Ondo Finance helps popularize tokenized Treasury products
events.summary: Ondo reported that USDY had surpassed $350 million in TVL, expanded to seven blockchains and reached more than 70 integrations; OUSG also integrated BlackRock's BUIDL as underlying reserve infrastructure.
events.significance: Ondo became one of the clearest bridges between DeFi and tokenized US Treasury exposure.

sources.title: Ondo Finance — Building on BUIDL
Ondo Finance — One Year of USDY

events.title: Arkham publicly identifies Bhutan's state-linked Bitcoin holdings
events.summary: Arkham Intelligence publicly labeled wallets it attributed to Bhutan's government investment arm, Druk Holding & Investments, showing more than $750 million of Bitcoin and linking the holdings to state-backed mining.
events.significance: The disclosure drew global attention to a sovereign Bitcoin strategy based on mining rather than mainly criminal-asset seizures.

sources.title: Arkham — Bhutan Government's BTC holdings
IMF — Bhutan Article IV report on public-sector Bitcoin estimates

events.notes: Bhutanese authorities have not publicly confirmed Arkham's exact wallet/holding estimates.

events.title: MakerDAO becomes Sky and launches USDS/SKY upgrade path
events.summary: Maker's Endgame transition rebranded the ecosystem as Sky and launched the USDS and SKY token upgrade path in September 2024 while DAI and MKR continued to coexist.
events.significance: The change was one of the largest governance and product restructurings of a foundational DeFi protocol.

sources.title: Maker/Sky whitepaper — 2024 Sky rebrand and USDS
Maker Governance — USDS/SKY initialization executive

events.title: Dubai VARA 2024 virtual-asset marketing regulations take effect
events.summary: Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority put updated 2024 marketing regulations for virtual assets and related activities into effect on 1 October.
events.significance: The rules tightened how licensed and unlicensed entities could market crypto products in a jurisdiction that had simultaneously positioned itself as a major virtual-asset hub.

sources.title: VARA — 2024 Marketing Regulations

events.title: Radiant Capital loses more than $50 million in a multisig compromise
events.summary: Radiant Capital suffered a sophisticated compromise in which attackers manipulated signing interfaces on compromised developer devices and drained more than $50 million across Arbitrum and BNB Chain markets.
events.significance: The attack showed that multisig security can fail at the signer-device and interface layer even when transaction approval appears legitimate.

sources.title: Radiant Capital DAO — October 16 exploit post-mortem

events.title: Scroll launches SCR and its first community airdrop
events.summary: Scroll launched SCR on 22 October 2024 and opened its first airdrop, with 7% of supply allocated to the initial distribution.
events.significance: SCR joined the wave of major Ethereum Layer-2 token distributions and linked token ownership to Scroll's decentralization roadmap.

sources.title: Scroll — SCR Token
Scroll — First Airdrop

events.title: Stacks Nakamoto upgrade advances Bitcoin L2 narrative
events.summary: Stacks activated its Nakamoto upgrade on mainnet, introducing faster blocks and Bitcoin finality for Stacks transactions.
events.significance: The upgrade substantially changed Stacks' block-production/security model and strengthened its claim to function as a Bitcoin-aligned execution layer.

sources.title: Stacks — Nakamoto upgrade live
Stacks — Nakamoto testing / mainnet activation

events.title: Polymarket prediction markets reach mainstream scale
events.summary: Reuters reported that Polymarket's 2024 US presidential-election market had reached about $3.1 billion in trading volume by 4 November 2024, reflecting unprecedented mainstream attention for a crypto-based prediction market.
events.significance: The 2024 cycle moved prediction markets from a crypto niche into mainstream reporting and public discussion of market-based forecasting.

sources.title: Reuters — U.S. election speculators play the prediction markets
Polymarket — 2024 Presidential Election market archive

events.notes: Historical market-activity record only. Market prices are not treated here as an election forecast or recommendation.

events.title: Uniswap announces $15.5M v4 bug bounty ahead of hooks-based launch
events.summary: Uniswap Labs announced a $15.5 million bug bounty for v4 ahead of launch, describing hooks as one of the protocol's defining extensibility features.
events.significance: The bounty became one of DeFi's largest pre-launch security programs and highlighted how v4's hook architecture was expected to make AMM behavior highly customizable.

sources.title: Uniswap — v4 Bug Bounty
Uniswap Developers — v4 Hooks

events.title: Bitcoin trades above $100,000 for the first time
events.summary: Bitcoin rose above $100,000 for the first time on 5 December 2024; Reuters reported an intraday high of $103,649.
events.significance: Crossing six figures was a major psychological and cultural price milestone after sixteen years of Bitcoin history.

sources.title: Reuters — Bitcoin storms above $100,000

events.notes: Use Reuters' quoted market high rather than presenting one universal exchange price.

events.title: IMF negotiations intensify scrutiny of El Salvador Bitcoin law
events.summary: IMF staff and El Salvador reached a staff-level agreement on a $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility under which planned legal reforms would make private-sector Bitcoin acceptance voluntary, confine public-sector Bitcoin activity and gradually unwind government participation in Chivo.
events.significance: The agreement marked a major retrenchment from the compulsory elements of El Salvador's 2021 Bitcoin legal-tender experiment.

sources.title: IMF — Staff-Level Agreement with El Salvador

events.title: MiCA's broader crypto framework begins applying across the EU
events.summary: The broader provisions of the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation began applying on 30 December 2024 after the earlier June stablecoin phase.
events.significance: MiCA created a harmonized EU-wide regulatory framework for crypto-asset service providers and many crypto issuers.

sources.title: EUR-Lex — MiCA summary
European Commission — Digital finance, December 2024
